article_notes: Prospective study of 23 dogs with PCR-confirmed acute B. canis infection (samples sent to Laboklin, Germany), followed at T0, T1 and T2 after imidocarb. No severity or outcome grouping: all dogs survived and only 1 of 16 with data had a complicated course, so no comparison was made. The haematological score (HES) is reported only by time point. Correlations (Tables 3, 4, 6) are between laboratory markers, antibody levels, parasite load and rectal temperature, not against a severity measure, so they are not extracted. No infected-vs-healthy comparisons.

not_extracted.what: Babesia antibody status vs disease severity (three seropositive imported dogs described as clinically unremarkable, with the lowest parasite loads and only mild thrombocytopenia)
not_extracted.note: Descriptive for 3 dogs only; the antibody correlations are with individual lab markers, not a severity measure.
